record.one_liner: All-in-one marketing, CRM and agency platform (GoHighLevel / HighLevel) with a documented public API and an official MCP server.
record.auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 and Private Integration Tokens (PIT). PIT is a bearer token, counted as api_key per the rubric. Legacy API key generation is being phased out per the official docs.
record.access_notes: critic: access paid_plan -> self_serve_trial. Pricing page offers a 14-day free trial with full access to the chosen tier, and API access (OAuth and Private Integration Tokens) is available across plans including Starter. A free Marketplace developer account (sign up, phone and email verification) lets you create OAuth apps, but installing/using them needs a HighLevel account. No permanently free plan.
record.api_notes: Versioned REST-style API with bearer auth (v2 and v3 routes). Some higher-tier endpoints are restricted by plan, scope or eligibility. api_style is inferred from the v3 bearer-auth reference; the page does not use the word REST.
record.blocker_notes: critic: blocked/paid_plan -> ready/none. A 14-day free trial gives full tier access so credentials can be obtained self-serve; ongoing production use needs a paid subscription after the trial, and marketplace publishing has a submission workflow, but building and testing is not blocked.
